RRB Paramedical Result 2026 Out

The Railway RRB Paramedical Exam was held on 11th March to 13th March for the posts of Nursing Superintendent, Dialysis Technician, Health & Malaria Inspector, Pharmacist, Radiographer, ECG Technician Grade II. Is RRB Paramedical Result and Scorecard 2026 Out? Yes, the Railway Paramedical Staff Result 2026 has been uploaded on 29th May along with merit list pdf, scorecard, cut off marks. The result is available in PDF format on the official website. Candidates can check their roll numbers in the selection list to view qualifying status. Along with the result, the RRB Paramedical scorecard 2026 has also been released at the official website rrb.digialm.com.

How to Download RRB Paramedical Result 2026?

RRB Paramedical Result can be checked online through the official website. Candidates need to download the result PDF and search for roll number to check qualifying status. Candidates can follow the steps below to download the result

  1. Visit the RRB official website @rrbcdg.gov.in.
  2. Click on CEN 03/2025 Paramedical Result CBT.
  3. Open the result PDF displayed on the screen.
  4. Search for roll number.
  5. Check qualifying status in the list.
  6. Download and save the PDF for future reference.

What are the Details Mentioned on the RRB Paramedical Result 2026?

RRB Paramedical Result PDF contains important exam and candidate-related details. Candidates should carefully check all important information mentioned in the list. Below are the details mentioned in the result.

  1. Candidate’s Roll Number
  2. Category (General/OBC/SC/ST)
  3. Post Name
  4. Allotted RRB Region
  5. Qualification Status

What’s Next After the RRB Paramedical Result 2026?

After the RRB Paramedical Result, shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification. Candidates must carry original certificates along with self-attested photocopies. After DV, a medical examination will be conducted at designated railway hospitals. Final selection will be based on documents and medical clearance before the joining process.

Q1. Is RRB Paramedical Result 2026 been released?

Ans. Yes, the RRB Paramedical Staff result 2026 has been released on 29th May on the official website.

Q2. Where can I check the RRB Paramedical Result 2026?

Ans. Candidates can check the result on the official website @rrbcdg.gov.in & regional RRB portals.

Q3. What details are mentioned in the result PDF?

Ans. The result PDF includes the roll numbers of shortlisted candidates.

Q4. What is the next stage after the result?

Ans. After the RRB Paramedical Result, shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification & Medical Examination.

Q5. Is the RRB Paramedical Scorecard available?

Ans. Yes, the scorecard is available for candidates to check individual performance.
